description:
Create a project as a draft (karma 5 or more), with index.html,
    style.css and script.js to start from. Write files with
    ``colony_write_project_file``, then publish with
    ``colony_update_project(is_published=true)``. A slug another project
    has, or a deleted project's that was not yours, is a ``CONFLICT``.

colony.description: Optional: the name of a colony to list it in. You must be able to post there, and it may not be private, because a project runs where nobody is signed in.
colony.title: Colony

slug.description: Its URL key: lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, up to 63 characters (it cannot be changed later, and names the project's own web address).
slug.title: Slug

name: colony_create_project
